name: HLR Lookup
summary: Live HLR and mobile number portability lookups: whether a phone number is live, its type, and its original and current network.

api_key.description: your hlrlookup.com API key (account > API settings)

api_secret.description: the API secret paired with that key

notes: hlrlookup.com, not the different provider hlr-lookups.com.
Every call is a POST with a JSON body; the credentials travel in that body (this entry adds them).
Send one number as telephone_number, or up to 80 in requests; more than 80 is a BAD_REQUEST.
429 Too many requests means the API is busy; back off and retry.
Non-200 responses and per-result errors such as INSUFFICIENT_CREDIT, BAD_FORMAT and NO_COVERAGE are not charged.

endpoints.name: Live HLR lookup of a phone number
endpoints.summary: Number type, live status (LIVE, DEAD, ABSENT_SUBSCRIBER...), original and current network, porting, for one number or up to 80.

telephone_number.description: One number: international E.164 digits without '+', or national format with input_format set. Use this or requests.

requests.description: Batch of up to 80 items, each {telephone_number, and any of the options below}. Use this or telephone_number.

input_format.description: '' (default) for international input, or the ISO3 country code when the number is national.

output_format.description: Format of formatted_telephone_number: '', E164, PLUS_E164, NATIONAL, or an ISO3 country code.

cache_days_global.description: Accept a shared cached result up to this many days old, 0 to 30.

cache_days_private.description: Accept an account-private cached result up to this many days old, 0 to 30.

save_to_cache.description: Write the new result to the shared cache, not at all, or privately.

get_ported_date.description: Return ported_date when available; default NO.

get_landline_status.description: Return landline_status when available; default NO.

usa_status.description: For US numbers, return live status instead of NOT_AVAILABLE_NETWORK_ONLY; costs an extra credit per lookup.

get_imsi_hash.description: Return an IMSI hash under current_network_details when available.

notes: A read over POST that spends credits (credits_spent per result). Cached network data (cache_days_*) can lower the charge; ported dates, usa_status and landline status add to it.
The response is always {results: [...]}; each item has error 'NONE' or its own error, e.g. TOO_MANY_REQUESTS for one throttled item in a batch.

endpoints.name: Number portability lookup
endpoints.summary: Original and current network and whether the number is ported, without the live HLR status.

telephone_number.description: One number: international E.164 digits without '+', or national format with input_format set. Use this or requests.

requests.description: Batch of up to 80 items, each {telephone_number, and any of the options below}. Use this or telephone_number.

input_format.description: '' (default) for international input, or the ISO3 country code when the number is national.

output_format.description: Format of formatted_telephone_number: '', E164, PLUS_E164, NATIONAL, or an ISO3 country code.

cache_days_global.description: Accept a shared cached result up to this many days old, 0 to 30.

cache_days_private.description: Accept an account-private cached result up to this many days old, 0 to 30.

save_to_cache.description: Write the new result to the shared cache, not at all, or privately.

get_ported_date.description: Return ported_date when available; default NO.

notes: A read over POST that spends credits: half the price of an HLR lookup; a ported date is charged on top. For +1 (NANP) numbers telephone_number_type is left out of results.
usa_status and landline status do not work on this endpoint.
